headline_examples.headline_text: TRUMP SAYS THERE CAN'T BE A DEADLINE.
TRUMP STATED HE WOULD VISIT UKRAINE AND PREFERS AN END TO THE WAR.
TRUMP BELIEVES UKRAINE CAN FAST-TRACK PRODUCTION OF PATRIOT MISSILES.
TRUMP DOES NOT BELIEVE RUSSIA WILL ATTACK UKRAINE AGAIN AFTER THE WAR ENDS. HE SAID PATRIOT PRODUCTION LICENSES WILL BE QUICK TO OBTAIN, BUT NOT ENOUGH PATRIOTS ARE AVAILABLE FOR U.S. NEEDS.
IMF OFFICIAL SAYS CENTRAL BANK MESSAGES ARE CRUCIAL IN TIMES OF GREAT UNCERTAINTY.
TRUMP DISCUSSES SECURITY GUARANTEE FOR UKRAINE, PROMISING SUPPORT FOR EUROPE WITH A SECURITY PACKAGE IF A GOOD DEAL IS REACHED.
*TRUMP: DON'T SEE RUSSIA ATTACKING UKRAINE AGAIN AFTER WAR END
*TRUMP: I WOULD GO TO UKRAINE, WOULD RATHER HAVE THE WAR BE OVER
*TRUMP: WE DON'T HAVE THAT MANY PATRIOTS, NEED THEM FOR OURSELVES *TRUMP: THINK UKRAINE WILL BE ABLE TO PRODUCE PATRIOTS QUICKLY

🚨The FBI just got caught with a secret room full of hidden sealed Seth Rich files that they claimed didn’t exist for years. Our Chief White House Correspondent Gary Franchi Reports @nextnews @TrumpDailyPosts

🚨 Hidden FBI room. Seth Rich files inside. After years of “no records,” the paper trail suddenly appears in a sealed Hoover SCIF tied to burn bags. Who hid them—and why? Comey’s FBI has serious questions to answer. Watch this now. https://t.co/3Kt4CjzlHK
Trump: Putin wants to meet Zelenskiy in Moscow, not likely.
Trump on war in Ukraine: Putin wants to meet in Moscow
RUTTE FROM NATO SAYS HE CONFIDENTLY BELIEVES TRUMP AND THE U.S. ARE FULLY DEDICATED TO NATO.
TRUMP SAYS PUTIN WANTS A MEETING IN MOSCOW REGARDING THE UKRAINE WAR.
NATO'S RUTTE NOTED A STRONG FEELING OF SOLIDARITY AMONG 32 LEADERS IN THE ROOM.
TRUMP EXPRESSES DESIRE TO ARRANGE A MEETING REGARDING THE WAR IN UKRAINE SOON.
NATO WILL INVEST €27 BILLION TO IMPROVE FUEL SUPPLY LINES, SAYS RUTTE.
TRUMP BELIEVES THAT RUSSIA'S TERMS FOR ENDING THE WAR ARE EVOLVING.
ZELENSKIY INTENDS TO TALK ABOUT A DRONE AGREEMENT WITH TRUMP AND BELIEVES RUSSIAN PEACE CONDITIONS ARE EVOLVING.
IMF OFFICIAL STRESSES THAT TARIFFS AND GLOBAL SPLIT ARE SIGNIFICANT RISKS, BUT NEW TRADE AGREEMENTS PROVIDE SOME POSITIVE POTENTIAL.
TRUMP BELIEVES PUTIN'S TERMS FOR ENDING THE UKRAINE WAR ARE EVOLVING.
TRUMP STATED HE DISCUSSES WITH PUTIN FREQUENTLY.
NATO'S RUTTE SAYS ALLIES ARE MAKING A SIGNIFICANT MOVE TO SECURE FUEL STORAGE FOR THE ALLIANCE.
IMF Official: Tariffs and fragmentation are important risk, but new trade deals offer some upside.
*TRUMP: I TALK TO ZELENSKYY A LITTLE LESS THAN PUTIN *TRUMP: TALK WITH PUTIN A LOT *TRUMP: THINK RUSSIA'S CONDITIONS FOR WAR END ARE CHANGING
MACRON WILL TALK ABOUT SUPPORT FOR UKRAINE'S AIR DEFENSE ON JULY 13.
MACRON CALLS US TROOP REDEPLOYMENT IN EUROPE 'LEGITIMATE'.
TRUMP TO HOLD DISCUSSION WITH PUTIN TODAY.
TRUMP STATES WE'LL PROVIDE SECURITY GUARANTEES IN UKRAINE TO SAVE LIVES.
Trump: I will be speaking with Putin today.
IMF OFFICIAL WARNED THAT AN INCREASE IN MIDDLE EAST TENSIONS POSES A SIGNIFICANT RISK TO THE WORLD ECONOMY.
TRUMP SAYS HE HAS PUT PRESSURE ON PUTIN, WHO ISN'T HAPPY ABOUT IT.
IMF official: An escalation of the Middle East conflict is a key downside risk facing the global economy
